newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks nose dive on Moody's ratings cut.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks nose dive on Moody's ratings cut.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plunged on Thursday amid a selling spree prompted by the downgrading of Pakistan's credit ratings by Moody's Investors Service Inc, but dealers said the market might improve slightly on Sunday.
"The market has over-reacted and players will take it as an oppurtunity to build fresh positions," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 70.08 points, or 4.43 percent, to end at 1,510.16. Losers led gainers 171 to 33. Turnover fell to 66.78 million shares from 84.41 million on Wednesday.
Faysal Bank fell 0.75 to 25 rupees, Adamjee Insurance 3.0 to 99, Dewan Salman Fibre 2.90 to 37.40, Hub Power Co 2.60 to 34.65 and Shell Pakistan 8.0 to 144.
Pakistan State Oil fell 6.0 to 394, PTCL fell 1.90 to 31.60, Fauji Fertilizer 4.0 to 83.25 and ICI Pakistan 1.95 to 20.30.
